fsm.description: Single-arm pick&place preceded by a perception detect: S_DETECT asks the locate action where the cube is, and retries itself until it is told. Grasp-loss during transport (lift/place_above/place) routes to S_RECOVER, which captures and holds the current pose.
fsm.name: detect_pick_single_fsm

description: Hold the TCP at the startup home pose
motions.name: home

description: Hold the home pose while the perception server is asked where the cube is
motions.name: detect-cube

description: Move TCP to the pre-grasp position above the cube along a path
motions.name: pick-above

description: Lower TCP straight down to the grasp height at the cube
motions.name: pick

description: Hold TCP at the current base-frame pose while the gripper closes
motions.name: grasp-hold

description: Raise TCP straight up while holding the cube
motions.name: lift

description: Move TCP laterally to the pre-place position above the place location
motions.name: place-above

description: Lower TCP with cube straight down to the place height
motions.name: place

description: Hold TCP at place pose while the gripper opens
motions.name: open-grasp-hold

description: Move TCP straight up to the pre-grasp height above the place location
motions.name: retreat

description: Fallback recovery: capture the current pose on entry and hold it
motions.name: recover
